verdict.rationale: monday.com's own docs describe an admin dashboard where you can 'audit every action' an agent takes across the org. That is a first-party admin audit capability, but it is only evidenced for AI agent actions, not for all actions taken across the workspace. The developer-platform 'logs' item is app runtime logging, not an admin audit log, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: evidence of a workspace-wide audit log covering human user and admin actions, details on log contents, filtering and export, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can review an admin audit log of actions taken across the workspace

citations.quote: Scope each agent's board access from the admin, audit every action it takes, and track AI credit spend across the whole org — all from one dashboard.
